design.status_of_evidence: Lee2019 participants and pairs as in C3/C4 (independent of HS-Stroke, not of C3/C4); the fine shifts were never fitted
design.shifts: copies [d, d + 2) s for d = 0, 62.5, 125, 250, 500, 1000 ms of the scored window [0, 2) s; window-local filtering
design.pairs: C3 pairs; per task an outcome-blind 5 of 40 (rng [7701, participant, run]) for both models (same pairs)
design.models: TS+LR exact optimum (per-arm Karcher + damped Newton) and EEGNet-8,2 exactly as C2/C3b/C4b (CRN, A/A per task)
design.inference: 54 participants; t95 CI; MC sign-flip (1e6, seed 7499); Holm over the 6-test family

hypotheses_declared_before_any_fit.basis: C4 (TS+LR: d 12.84 -> 8.31 -> 5.63 at 0 / 0.5 / 1 s shifts) and C4b (EEGNet: 13.30 -> 1.14 at 0 / 1 s): EEGNet's advantage is tied to the time-aligned waveform; its pooled temporal resolution is 0.25 s (8 bins over 2 s)
hypotheses_declared_before_any_fit.H1_mechanistic_scale: EEGNet's per-participant retained fraction d(shift) / d(0) is > 0.5 at 62.5 ms (H3a) and < 0.5 at 250 ms (H3b): the decay happens on the scale of its pooled time bins
hypotheses_declared_before_any_fit.H2_model_contrast: EEGNet retains a smaller fraction than TS+LR at every shift (two-sided tests at 62.5, 125, 250, 500 ms)
hypotheses_declared_before_any_fit.guard: fractions are not computed if any participant's d(0) <= 0.5 points for either model
hypotheses_declared_before_any_fit.descriptive: full curves (6 shifts) per model with t95 CIs; first shift below half of d(0)
hypotheses_declared_before_any_fit.no_SESOI: no equivalence region and no post-hoc relevance threshold
